apiBoundary: OCC controllers (commercewebservices) delegate to *Facade beans; business logic lives in the ServiceLayer (*Service/*Strategy/DAO), never in controllers — see the repo CLAUDE.md

build.TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE: ./gradlew yupdatesystem   # run with the server STOPPED
build.UNIT_TEST: cd hybris/bin/platform && . ./setantenv.sh && ant unittests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # stop the server first; the gradle passthrough drops -D and runs the whole platform suite
build.INTEGRATION_TEST: cd hybris/bin/platform && . ./setantenv.sh && ant integrationtests -Dtestclasses.extensions=<ext>   # server stopped; re-run 'ant yunitinit' after any *-items.xml change

researchLayers.name: extensions
researchLayers.targets: extensioninfo.xml dependency graph, dev-config/localextensions.xml, bin/custom/* layout

researchLayers.name: type-system
researchLayers.targets: *-items.xml custom types/relations/enums, deployment tables, generated model usage

researchLayers.name: occ-web
researchLayers.targets: commercewebservices controllers, *-beans.xml WsDTO/Data, OCC field sets, *Facade beans

researchLayers.name: impex-data
researchLayers.targets: resources/impex/, essentialdata/projectdata load order, catalog versions, Solr config

_notes: Starter profile for an SAP Commerce (Hybris) CCv2 backend. Copy to working-docs/config.json and set <ext> to your extension(s).

ANT variant: set buildTool=ant and swap the verbs — BUILD '. ./setantenv.sh && ant build', FULL_BUILD 'ant clean all', TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE 'ant updatesystem', SERVER_RESTART './hybrisserver.sh stop | ./hybrisserver.sh start', IMPEX_IMPORT 'MANUAL: import the file via the HAC ImpEx console'. UNIT_TEST/INTEGRATION_TEST already use the ant form. If there is no core-customize/ wrapper, set workingDir to 'hybris'.
Always 'yclean' before 'ybuild' — incremental Java compilation is unreliable here and can leave stale .class files on a green build.

Run TYPE_SYSTEM_UPDATE and all tests with the server STOPPED: yupdatesystem needs the server down (a running server makes ant attempt a JMX wrapper restart that fails), and the junit tenant shuts down Solr on 8983, which is shared with the live server.

Scope tests to custom extensions only; never run the full platform suite unless asked. Do NOT use ./gradlew yunittests/yintegrationtests with -D flags (the plugin drops them) — use the ant form above.
Never edit gensrc/, platform/, or OOTB modules — override in custom extensions. Use the Spring alias pattern (defaultMyBean -> myBean). OCC Data/WsDTO classes are generated from *-beans.xml.

Set jira.mode to 'mcp' if the Atlassian MCP connector is available in your Claude Code session; 'manual' if Jira exists but is unreachable (paste ticket in; updates written paste-ready); 'none' if there is no Jira.
